summary: Phase 4B (Refund Deduction & Non-Refundable Cost) FRONTEND-ONLY testing PASSED end-to-end. Seeded QA4B-B1 booking (30jt total, 20jt paid) and drove cancellation to CALCULATED refund via API (proposed=18M after 2M cancellation_fee). Then ran Playwright UI E2E covering all 4 scenarios in review_request: (1) ACCOUNTING /approvals -> Refund tab -> rf-open-<id> opened rf-detail-dialog, rf-deduction-table renders with 'Total Deduction' and 'Final/Proposed Refund' rows (initial 18.000.000). Filled rf-ded-type=Visa + rf-ded-method=PER_PAX + rf-ded-qty=2 + rf-ded-unit=1000000, clicked rf-add-ded -> new row appears in table AND Proposed Refund decreased by 2,000,000 (18M -> 16M). Clicked rf-del-ded-<id> -> row removed and Proposed restored to 18M. Also verified rf-adj-amount is NOT visible for Accounting (count=0). (2) SUPER ADMIN opens same refund -> rf-adj-amount/rf-adj-reason/rf-adj-save all visible (count=1). Applying +500000 with EMPTY reason -> toast error 'Reason wajib' (reason required). Applying +500000 with reason 'SA goodwill' -> Proposed Refund updated to 18.500.000 and a 'Refund Adjustment' row appeared in tfoot with Rp 500.000. (3) SALES /approvals -> tab-refund is visible, refund row visible read-only; opening the dialog shows NO adjust box, NO add-deduction controls, NO approve button (adj=0, add=0, approve=0). (4) Process cap: Accounting submitted rf-submit-review (bank BCA/1234567/QA4B Test) -> ACCOUNTING_REVIEWED. SA clicked rf-approve -> APPROVED. Accounting saw rf-process. Entering 20,000,000 (> approved 18.5M) -> toast error 'Pembayaran melebihi approved refund (sisa Rp 18.500.000). Ajukan revisi ke Super Admin.' (cap enforced). Partial 10,000,000 -> status PARTIALLY_REFUNDED. Remainder 8,500,000 -> status REFUNDED. deduction-types API populates the datalist (15 defaults per backend). All data-testids from the spec render and behave per RBAC.
critical_code_review_comments: Approvals.jsx RefundDetail: rf-adj-save error message is 'Reason wajib' — clear and matches spec (reason required).
Process cap error toast wording is user-friendly and shows the remaining allowed amount (sisa) — nice UX.
Delete-deduction button (rf-del-ded-<id>) is only rendered when editable && canReview, so non-refund.review roles cannot mutate — correct RBAC.
Consider clearing the pay-amount input to 0 (or refreshing d.refunded_amount) immediately after a partial process; currently the field retains the last typed value which is minor cosmetic UX.
server.py still ~700+ lines with phase4b additions — consider extracting refund/deduction router.
Approvals.jsx also grew (~300 lines) with 4B additions; splitting RefundDetail into its own file (RefundDetail.jsx) would improve maintainability.
